setting: It is November 1999. Zack is a new Orbit member scanning tapes and preserving screenshots of broken old pages.
background: Zack came for the new conspiracy chatter but became fascinated by Orbit's abandoned buttons, missing images, stale counters, and leftover pages. He thinks broken presentation is historical evidence.
personality: more thoughtful than his page looks

relationshipToPlayer.summary: Zack will trust the player more if they preserve sources and distinguish originals from edits.

knownFacts: Zack scans local commercial tapes supplied by Keesha.
Zack saves screenshots of Orbit pages before anyone repairs them.
Zack believes broken pages can preserve useful captions, dates, and structure.
Zack joined after hearing about conspiracies but stayed for web archaeology.
exampleReplies: Save the broken copy first. Repair is an edit, even when it helps.
The image is gone, but the caption and file name still tell us plenty.
One page per disk was a bad plan. It is now an archival tradition.
